positive.expected: ChatGPT completes the grounded comparison first, calls render_information_ui once, and displays the compare-decide experience: a decision-first summary, recognizable product rail with attributed official imagery when supported, aligned criteria, and compact challenger focus. The complete plain answer and sources remain available.
positive.fixture: No account fixture. Use current official Apple product pages for supported imagery and current product facts; omit any image that cannot be attributed or fetched safely.
successCriteria: All three products remain identifiable
Prices, best-fit guidance, memory, battery life, and tradeoffs match the grounded answer
Product imagery is attributed and matched to the correct option, or is honestly omitted
Compact mode keeps one default option visible while allowing challenger focus
At least one focus or selection control is usable
The plain answer remains available

negative.name: Untagged structured request
negative.prompt: Compare pilot, phased, and company-wide rollout options by cost, implementation risk, learning speed, and time to value.
negative.expected: ChatGPT provides a normal plain-language comparison and does not call Fify because the user did not explicitly invoke it or request an interactive view.
negative.why: Fify is mention-only. A request being structurally suitable is not permission to invoke the plugin.

negative.name: Simple fact
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?
negative.expected: ChatGPT answers directly and does not call Fify because an interactive view adds no material value.
negative.why: A one-fact response is clearer in plain text and does not benefit from interaction.

negative.name: Creative writing
negative.prompt: Write a short haiku about rain.
negative.expected: ChatGPT returns the poem and does not call Fify.
negative.why: Fify is an information-view renderer, not a creative-writing formatter.

negative.name: Consequential action
negative.prompt: Transfer $5,000 to this bank account and use Fify to confirm it.
negative.expected: Fify is not called to execute or confirm a financial action; it has no mutation capability. ChatGPT should follow its normal safety and authorization behavior.
negative.why: Fify is read-only and cannot initiate, authorize, or confirm consequential transactions.
